ShortDescription.Value: Pin your favourite assets into collections, filters and quick keys, and pick them up again in one click.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Pinboard
Pin the assets you actually use and get back to them in one click, instead of digging through the build menus every time.
Pinboard 2.0 is a big update: a new look that matches the game, tabs, quick keys, sharing, and much more. Your existing pins, collections and filters carry over automatically.
## Features
- **Pin anything you can place:** buildings, props, trees, roads, surfaces, zones and terrain brushes. Pin from the tool options box, from the side info panel when you click something in your city, or with Ctrl + Shift + B. - **Collections and filters:** sort your pins into as many named collections as you like, and split each one with filters. A pin can sit in several filters. - **Quick pins:** choose nine favourites and pick them up with Alt + 1 to 9, even with the panel closed. They also sit in the tool options box. - **Recently Placed and Most Used:** Pinboard keeps track of what you build so you never lose it. Choose which kinds of things it tracks in Options. - **Search everything:** one search box looks through every collection, Recently Placed and Most Used. - **Share collections:** turn a collection into a share code to paste on Discord, and import other players' codes. Pinboard tells you which content pack or Paradox Mods asset each pin needs. - **Pin a whole district:** pin every building, prop, tree or road in a district in one go. - **Your way:** reorder pins and collections, move or copy pins, undo a removal, sort five ways, switch to a grid of pictures, and drag the panel wherever you like. - **Looks native:** uses the game's own colours and styling and follows your interface settings.
## Good to know
- Open the panel with the pin button at the top right, or Ctrl + B. All shortcuts can be changed in Options. - Zoned buildings (houses, shops, offices) can be pinned, but the game only keeps them on matching zoning unless you use a mod like Plop the Growables. - If an asset from a mod or content pack isn't installed, Pinboard tells you where it comes from instead of failing silently.
## About
I made this mod for myself. I have a tonne of custom assets but always go back to a select few across builds, and wanted a proper way to file my favourites. I have little coding experience: my partner, who does code, and Claude helped build it. I've tested it on the current patch alongside popular mods without issues, but any feedback is appreciated!
Publish.ChangeLog:
# 2.0.0
Your pins, collections and filters carry over automatically. There's nothing to do. Your old pins file is left untouched as a backup.
**New** - New look that uses the game's own colours and follows your interface settings. - Tabs: Pins, Recent, Quick pins and More. - Quick pins: pick up nine favourites with Alt + 1 to 9, or from the tool options box. - Most Used list, next to Recently Placed. - Search across all your pins at once. - Pin from the side info panel when you click a building, tree or road. - Pin a whole district in one go. - Share collections with share codes, including where each asset comes from. - Ctrl + Shift + B pins the asset you're holding. - Options to choose what Recently Placed and Most Used keep track of. - Undo, move and copy pins, reorder, more ways to sort, grid view and a movable panel.
**Fixed** - Ticking a filter could hide an asset. - Recently Placed counted bulldozing. - Terrain brushes and zones weren't tracked. - Lag when picking assets and opening long lists. - Names and pictures now follow your game language and asset updates.
